source_title: About the Information Codes On a Samsung washing machine | Samsung SG
note: Text copied verbatim from the page's information-code table (static HTML). Codes on the page that are not in that table are not included.

steps: Make sure the water taps are open.
Make sure the water hoses are not clogged.
Make sure the water taps are not frozen.
Make sure the washing machine is operating with sufficient water pressure.
Make sure that the cold water tap and the hot water tap are properly connected.
Clean the mesh filter as it may be clogged.
All buttons will be disabled for 3 minutes after the information codes appears.
Make sure the drain hose is not frozen or clogged.
Make sure the drain hose is positioned correctly, depending on the connection type.
Clean the debris filter as it may be clogged.
Make sure the drain hose is straightened all the way to the drain system.
If the information code remains, contact a customer service center.

entries.meaning: Operating the washing machine with the door open.
steps: Make sure the door is properly closed.
Make sure laundry is not caught in the door.
Restart after spinning.
If the information code remains on the display, contact a local Samsung service center.
Make sure laundry is spread out evenly.
Make sure the washing machine is on a flat, stable surface.
Redistribute the load.
If only one item or clothing needs washing, check message will be shown in the display.

entries.meaning: Check communications between main and sub PBAs.
steps: Turn the machine off, and restart the cycle.
If the information code remains, contact a customer service center.

entries.meaning: The Add Door opened without pressing Start/Pause (Hold to Start). This message appears when you open the Add Door without pressing Start/Pause (Hold to Start). If this happens, do one of the following:
steps: Press the Add Door to close properly. Then, press and hold Start/Pause (Hold to Start) and try again.
To add laundry, open the Add Door and input laundry. Close the Add Door properly. Then, press and hold Start/Pause (Hold to Start) to resume operation.
